steps.name: apply-stage23a-multistep-virtual-hil
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=b5ed93eafae6fe5559cc714a79f9651a4969b135; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; rm -f warnings.txt; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage23/apply_stage23a_virtual_hil.py > /tmp/apply-stage23a-virtual-hil.py; .venv/bin/python /tmp/apply-stage23a-virtual-hil.py; .venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --files test/test_climate_virtual_hil/test_main.cpp || true; .venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --files test/test_climate_virtual_hil/test_main.cpp; git diff --check; git status --short
